scope: Cross-corpus guardrail for one SciFact-selected candidate strategy; the NFCorpus score may veto general deployment, never select another strategy using its labels. Official test and dev qrels excluded.
sample_algorithm: First 128 TRAIN query IDs sorted by SHA-256(salt + ':' + ID). Only the query-ID column was read to select. No inspection of positive grades or text during registration.

retrieval.render: title plus two newlines plus text
retrieval.baseline: RRF k=60, ties broken by best source rank then chunk ID
retrieval.corpus: entire official NFCorpus corpus; positive means upstream grade > 0

guardrail.note: Report retained/gained/lost query counts, and gross newly covered/lost positive query-document pairs even when net nonnegative. An improvement on SciFact does not establish improvements outside its measured corpora. Negative transfer prevents a global default switch.
